title: Network

panels.title: HTTP 5xx
panels.description: Server-error responses as a fraction of HTTPS requests over five minutes. No traffic produces no ratio.

panels.title: Blocking Enabled
panels.description: Enabled only when every reporting Blocky replica has blocking enabled.

panels.title: Oldest List Refresh
panels.description: Age of the oldest refresh timestamp among reporting Blocky replicas.

panels.title: Gateway Request Duration
panels.description: Duration observed by the HTTPS gateway, including upstream work.

targets.expr: label_replace(((sum by (envoy_cluster_name) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{envoy_cluster_name=~"httproute/.*"}[5m]))) and (topk(8, sum by (envoy_cluster_name) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{envoy_cluster_name=~"httproute/.*"}[5m]))) @ end())), "route", "$1", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/(.*)/rule/.*")

label_replace(((sum by (envoy_cluster_name) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{envoy_cluster_name=~"httproute/.*",envoy_response_code_class="5"}[5m]))) and (topk(8, sum by (envoy_cluster_name) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{envoy_cluster_name=~"httproute/.*",envoy_response_code_class="5"}[5m]))) @ end())), "route", "$1", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/(.*)/rule/.*")

panels.title: Busiest DNS Clients
panels.description: Current query rates, averaged over five minutes.

panels.title: External HTTP Checks
panels.description: Google and Cloudflare checked from inside the cluster. Failure can originate in local DNS, routing or the external path.

panels.title: Published TLS Expiry
panels.description: Earliest certificate-chain expiry among configured published HTTP endpoints.

panels.title: Endpoint Checks
panels.description: Checks run inside the cluster and follow HTTP redirects. These are reachability checks, not application tests.

panels.title: Cilium Reporting
panels.description: Expected: three metrics targets. This does not establish full datapath health.

panels.title: Drops by Reason
panels.description: Observed packet drops by reason. Policy denials can be intentional.

panels.title: Policy Denials in Selected Range

targets.expr: (sum by(source_namespace,source,destination_namespace,destination)(increase_prometheus(hubble_drop_total{reason="POLICY_DENIED"}[$__range])) > 0) or on () (label_replace(vector(0), "source", "No policy denials", "", "") and on () (min(up{job="hubble-metrics"}) == 1))

panels.description: Estimated dropped-flow counts over the selected time range.

panels.title: Unmatched Routes (1h)
panels.description: Requests that did not match a route.

panels.title: Backend p99 Duration

targets.expr: label_replace(((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, envoy_cluster_name) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{envoy_cluster_name=~"httproute/.*"}[5m])))) and (topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, envoy_cluster_name) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{envoy_cluster_name=~"httproute/.*"}[5m])))) @ end())), "route", "$1", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/(.*)/rule/.*")

panels.description: Request duration measured by Envoy for each upstream route.

panels.title: Healthy Backends
panels.description: Endpoints Envoy currently considers healthy for each route.

panels.title: Failed Downloads (24h)
panels.description: Failed denylist download attempts in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: List Entries by Replica
panels.description: Entries summed across list groups on each replica; groups can overlap.

panels.title: Upstream Resolvers
panels.description: Resolved-response rate by upstream resolver. A quiet series does not establish a failed resolver.

panels.title: CoreDNS Request Rate
panels.description: Cluster DNS request rate; separate from LAN queries served by Blocky.

panels.title: Unmanaged Pods
panels.description: Pods reported as unmanaged by the Cilium operator.

panels.title: BPF Map Pressure
panels.description: Fraction of each BPF map capacity in use.

description: Gateway errors, DNS activity and endpoint checks. Detailed network diagnostics are collapsed.
